## 2025-01-20 - [Redundant Client-Side Markdown Parsing]
**Learning:** Static sites generated by Jekyll render Markdown to HTML at build time. Including `marked.js` and `markdown.js` for client-side parsing is redundant and impacts performance (~44KB unused JS) unless `data-markdown` is explicitly used.
**Action:** Always verify if client-side libraries are duplicating work already done by the SSG.
